comment: Input of scripts/check_licenses.py. Update it together with THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md after reviewing a new or changed component; see docs/licensing-audit.md.

com.tencent:mmkv-static.note: POM declares BSD-3-Clause, but libmmkv.so also contains AES/MD5 code under the OpenSSL and SSLeay licenses (MMKV LICENSE.TXT), whose advertising clauses the FSF considers GPL-incompatible. LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED; see docs/licensing-audit.md.

com.squareup.okhttp3:okhttp.note: Apache-2.0 code; bundles the Public Suffix List data under MPL-2.0 (attributed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

androidx.camera:camera-core.note: Apache-2.0 and BSD-3-Clause (libyuv in libimage_processing_util_jni.so); both attributed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

libv2ray.aar geo data (geoip.dat, geosit.note: Bundled Loyalsoldier geo data includes MaxMind GeoLite2 data (GeoLite EULA), a hosts list licensed for non-commercial use only (Dan Pollock) and a list without a known license (Peter Lowe). LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED; see docs/licensing-audit.md.
